newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Singamas opens Xiamen container depot.
newsitem.headline: Singamas opens Xiamen container depot.

text.p: Singamas Container Holdings Ltd said its 30,000 sq m container depot in China's Xiamen began operations on Monday.
The joint venture, 51 percent owned by Singamas and the rest by Xiamen Xiangyu (Group) Co Ltd, is for a period of 20 years at an initial investment of US$3 million, it said.
The facility has room to store 4,500 TEU and provides container repair, transloading consolidation, haulage, reefer point and reefer repair services.
Singamas has two container depots in Hong Kong and one each in Shanghai, Ningbo, Tianjin and Qingdao.
